// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

//
// Align reads with bwa-mem3 (plain, bisulfite/EM-seq `--meth` or TAPS `--meth=taps`, set via BWAMEM3_MEM ext.args),
// coordinate-sort and index, optionally mark duplicates, and collect samtools stats
//

include { BWAMEM3_MEM           } from 'nf-core/bwamem3/mem'
include { PICARD_MARKDUPLICATES } from 'nf-core/picard/markduplicates'
include { SAMTOOLS_INDEX        } from 'nf-core/samtools/index'
include { BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS    } from 'nf-core/bam_stats_samtools'

workflow FASTQ_ALIGN_DEDUP_BWAMEM3 {
    take:
    ch_reads // channel: [ val(meta), [ reads ] ]
    ch_fasta_fai // channel: [ val(meta), fasta, fai ]
    ch_bwamem3_index // channel: [ val(meta), [ bwa-mem3 index ] ]
    skip_deduplication // boolean: whether to skip marking duplicates

    main:
    ch_picard_metrics = channel.empty()

    // Align, coordinate-sort and write a BAI in one step
    BWAMEM3_MEM(
        ch_reads,
        ch_bwamem3_index,
        ch_fasta_fai.map { meta, fasta, _fai -> [meta, fasta] },
        true,
        'bai',
    )
    ch_alignment = BWAMEM3_MEM.out.aligned
    ch_alignment_index = BWAMEM3_MEM.out.index

    if (!skip_deduplication) {
        PICARD_MARKDUPLICATES(
            ch_alignment,
            ch_fasta_fai,
        )
        SAMTOOLS_INDEX(PICARD_MARKDUPLICATES.out.bam)
        ch_alignment = PICARD_MARKDUPLICATES.out.bam
        ch_alignment_index = SAMTOOLS_INDEX.out.index
        ch_picard_metrics = PICARD_MARKDUPLICATES.out.metrics
    }

    // samtools stats, flagstat and idxstats on the final BAM
    BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS(
        ch_alignment.join(ch_alignment_index),
        ch_fasta_fai,
    )

    ch_multiqc_files = ch_picard_metrics
        .mix(BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS.out.stats)
        .mix(BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS.out.flagstat)
        .mix(BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS.out.idxstats)
        .collect { _meta, file -> file }

    emit:
    bam               = ch_alignment // channel: [ val(meta), bam ]
    index             = ch_alignment_index // channel: [ val(meta), bai ]
    samtools_flagstat = BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS.out.flagstat // channel: [ val(meta), flagstat ]
    samtools_stats    = BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS.out.stats // channel: [ val(meta), stats ]
    samtools_idxstats = BAM_STATS_SAMTOOLS.out.idxstats // channel: [ val(meta), idxstats ]
    picard_metrics    = ch_picard_metrics // channel: [ val(meta), metrics ]
    multiqc           = ch_multiqc_files // channel: [ files ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/fastq_align_dedup_bwamem3"
description: "Align DNA, bisulfite/EM-seq or TAPS reads with bwa-mem3, coordinate-sort\
  \ and index, optionally mark duplicates, and collect samtools stats"
keywords:
- "bwamem3"
- "alignment"
- "map"
- "5mC"
- "methylseq"
- "taps"
- "DNA"
- "fastq"
- "bam"
components:
- "bwamem3/mem"
- "picard/markduplicates"
- "samtools/index"
- "bam_stats_samtools"
input:
- ch_reads:
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data,\nrespectively.\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq,fastq.gz}"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome fasta file and its index\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fa.gz,fasta,fasta.gz}"
- ch_bwamem3_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "bwa-mem3 genome index. The alignment mode comes from BWAMEM3_MEM\
      \ `ext.args`:\nnone for plain DNA, `--meth` for bisulfite/EM-seq, `--meth=taps`\
      \ for TAPS.\nBoth methylation modes need an index built with `bwa-mem3 index\
      \ --meth`.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- skip_deduplication:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Skip marking duplicates with Picard MarkDuplicates\n"
output:
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Coordinate-sorted BAM (duplicate-marked unless skip_deduplication)\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAI index of the BAM\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bai"
- samtools_flagstat:
    type: "file"
    description: "samtools flagstat output\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(flagstat)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.flagstat"
- samtools_stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "samtools stats output\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.stats"
- samtools_idxstats:
    type: "file"
    description: "samtools idxstats output\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(idxstats)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.idxstats"
- picard_metrics:
    type: "file"
    description: "Duplicate metrics from Picard MarkDuplicates\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(metrics) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.metrics.txt"
- multiqc:
    type: "file"
    description: "Files for MultiQC (duplicate metrics, stats, flagstat, idxstats)\n\
      Structure: [ path(file) ]\n"
    pattern: "*{.txt,.stats,.flagstat,.idxstats}"
authors:
- "@eduard-watchmaker"
maintainers:
- "@eduard-watchmaker"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bwamem3/mem@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/picard/markduplicates@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/index@0.0.0-1b655c6"
  - "nf-core/bam_stats_samtools@0.0.0-df69bf6"
